content.question: According to the material, why is reinforcement learning well suited for solving real-world tasks?
options: Because it can learn successfully without any feedback from the environment
Because it is based on the agent's exploratory abilities instead of a prepared dataset
Because it always learns from large, carefully labeled datasets
Because it is limited to games and simulations, where mistakes have no real-world consequences
content.answer: Because it is based on the agent's exploratory abilities instead of a prepared dataset
